Materials villevite owns are already named after their class, so the 'materials' list is
normally empty -- it exists for materials that come from the Assets library and cannot be
renamed (several of them share one class, and Blender datablock names are unique).
Object rules are fnmatch patterns, tried in order, against the object name with Blender's
'.001' suffix removed. They classify geometry whose materials carry no class of their own.
